title: Replace logo with text-only 'Smileup' wordmark in TopBar and LandingPage

requirements.text: In TopBar.tsx, remove any logo image element and replace it with a text-only 'Smileup' wordmark. The wordmark should use the existing brand color combination (e.g., gradient or contrasting accent colors already present on the black page background) and have a clean, professional typographic style — no image assets.

quotes: hide it background colour white and just write the name Smileup with the same combination of colors that contrast on the black background of the pagee
remove the logo image and replace it with a stylish text-only 'Smileup' wordmark using the existing color combination

acceptanceCriteria: No logo image is rendered in the TopBar
The TopBar displays 'Smileup' as styled text using the existing brand accent colors
The wordmark looks sharp and professional against the black page background
No broken image references remain in the TopBar component

requirements.text: In LandingPage.tsx, remove any logo image element and replace it with the same text-only 'Smileup' wordmark — matching the typographic style and color treatment used in the TopBar. Ensure it reads clearly on the black background.

quotes: hide it background colour white and just write the name Smileup with the same combination of colors that contrast on the black background of the pagee

acceptanceCriteria: No logo image is rendered on the LandingPage
The LandingPage displays 'Smileup' as styled text using the same brand colors as the TopBar wordmark
The wordmark is legible and professional on the black background
No broken image references remain in the LandingPage component

requirements.text: If the app still references a splash/logo screen in App.tsx (shown during initialization), replace the logo image there too with the same text-only 'Smileup' wordmark for visual consistency.
acceptanceCriteria: The initialization splash screen shows 'Smileup' as styled text, not an image
The wordmark style is consistent with TopBar and LandingPage

constraints: Use only existing brand/accent colors already present in the app — do not introduce new colors
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Redesigning the overall color scheme or page layout
Adding any new logo image assets
Changing navigation structure or page routing
